nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: Keep the EXACT same camera position, angle, height, framing, and perspective from the 3D layout. Do NOT move, resize, rotate or reposition ANY object. Preserve the exact relative positions and distances of every element. The grey road surface becomes a weathered stone-paved coastal road leading directly toward the deep blue sea on the horizon. The geometric shapes along the road edges become tall classical Roman statues carved in warm ivory marble. Clear deep azure Mediterranean sky, strong late-afternoon sun, golden rim-light on marble statues, 35mm anamorphic, cinematic teal-gold grade.
